answer: The Ashbound ID registry deters clones via proof of burn. 1) A user routes fifty gas tokens into a locked contract inlet, destroying them forever. 2) The system mints a unique non-transferable passport, logging the lost wealth on-chain. 3) Applications siphon security nectar from this verification ledger to grant governance rights. Mass attacks fail because generating twenty thousand fake personas costs an attacker one million dollars upfront in incinerated funds. Fake accounts drop fast, like a blinded sparrow plunging from the sky when its paper wings catch fire.
